svg.title: Hosting a large knowledge repository — static reading, cited answers

g.text: Hosting a large knowledge repository — static reading, cited answers
Each edition is pre-rendered with a sharded search index. 'Ask this book' retrieves only from that edition and abstains when the evidence is missing.
1 · Readers open the edition site; reading and keyword search are static.
2 · Pre-rendered pages and search shards come from S3 through origin access control.
3 · 'Ask this book' goes to the API with WAF rate limits and anonymous quotas.
4 · The ask function takes the question and the edition.
5 · A recent answer for the same edition and normalised question is reused.
6 · Otherwise it retrieves from this edition only: lexical + vector, fused, with partition filters.
7 · Guardrails check the context for prompt attacks and the answer for grounding in the passages.
8 · The model answers only from the passages, citing edition + section; the medical profile adds abstention rules and a disclaimer.
10 · Vectors shipped in the pack are reused when the namespace matches; otherwise Bedrock embeds in batch.
11 · One index per edition; older editions stay searchable until the publisher retires them.
